newsitem.title: USA: CBOT-LIFFE link set for Friday, no CFTC nod yet.
newsitem.headline: CBOT-LIFFE link set for Friday, no CFTC nod yet.

text.p: The Chicago Board of Trade (CBOT) said the Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) had not yet approved the CBOT's link with the London International Financial Futures and Options Exchange (LIFFE).

"The CFTC has not yet approved the link between the CBOT and LIFFE with only 96 hours until the announced launch on May 9," CBOT president Thomas Donovan said Monday in a letter to CFTC chairwoman Brooksley Born.
The CBOT-LIFFE open outcry link is scheduled to start on Friday, May 9, with the opening of CBOT trading on LIFFE's German government bond contract at 1020 CDT/1520 GMT.
"The withholding of CFTC approval until this unacceptably late date is another vivid illustration of the competitive disability the agency has imposed on U.S. exchanges," Donovan said.
The CFTC had no immediate comment. ((Derivatives desk 312-408-8750)) E-mail derivatives@reuters.com
